caption:
Most owners believe in fast response.

Few have a written rule that enforces it.

A standard is one sentence every person on the team can repeat. It turns belief into consistency.

But even the best rule breaks when your team is on a roof, in a truck, or asleep.

Willpower won't cover the night shift. A system will.

DM TRIAL
#speedtolead #leadresponsetime #servicebusiness #homeservicemarketing #smallbusinessgrowth
rationale: Positions a written response standard as the real differentiator in speed-to-lead, using an honest general-pattern framing instead of an unverifiable cited statistic. Keeps the carousel's save-worthy structure while making every claim defensible.
